summary: Resolved the Twenty-first Sunday after Pentecost (catalog identity 61, roman-1962, II class, green) for Sunday 18 October 2026 on the 1962 typical edition's own page images (formulary nos. 1699-1708, printed pp. 413-415), its Calendarium and general rubrics, corroborated by computation and two live dated Ordos (FSSP France, ICRSP France). The occurring St Luke (II class, pp. 689-691) yields to the Sunday and is commemorated at low and conventual Masses only (RG 108, 111; RGMR 434, 437, 483: Collect 3883, Secret 3889, Postcommunion 3891, no Preface of Apostles). Because 18 October is the penultimate Sunday of October, RGMR 453 adds the oration pro Fidei propagatione (Tabula orationum p. 427, nos. 1806-1808) under one conclusion with the Sunday orations in every Mass, sung or low, unless the Ordinary set another mission day; the repository's rubrics computation omits this. The RGMR 369 II-class votive Mass Pro Fidei propagatione is recorded as a closed alternative. research/context.md holds the complete ten-element inventory with loci, the added orations, the Ordinary's text-bearing parts, the word-level divergences from the Clementine Vulgate (Introit cento on Esth 13:9-11, Gradual a generatione et progenie, Gospel suffocabat, Offertory narrative cento on Job 1-2, Communion cento), the lawful Latin routes (103(b) with the 1862 Pustet antecedent pp. 354-355 read on page images; 1862 St Luke pp. 560-561; 1889 Desclee text layer for the mission orations) and English routes (Douay-Rheims; Cummiskey 1861 pp. 450-452 and 677-678 and Lasance 1945 pp. 1453-1457, scans fetched to registered hashes and read), and the remaining source plan. main.tex was reserved as the scaffold comment only. No source was registered or retained.
